properties.site-address: Land adjacent to Fromehall, Bath Road Rodborough
properties.notes: Main constraints: Industrial Heritage Conservation Area, topography, land stability and access. Site investigation required. Summary: The site is considered suitable for housing or community development. However care will be needed as it contributes to the setting of historic buildings as well as the character of the conservation area. There will be a need to retain mature trees and secure safe access improvements to the local road and cycle network. There is no evidence that any of this area is available currently but there is a reasonable prospect that any suitable land will be available at a point in the future for development and that development as envisaged will be delivered on the site within 15 years.. This site could be developed for low density development typically comprising detached, semi -detached dwellings at an average low density of about 20 dph, and the suggested yield is 5 units taking account of levels and the need to retain tree cover.
